changelog:
StoreTap v2.1.0.12.5 UI & UX Update!

✨ ENHANCEMENTS:
- Dashboard & Offline Dashboard Revamp: Improved layout with search, filter, and sort tools.
- Refined Floating Cart Button: Now pill-shaped on desktop, draggable circle on mobile.
- Theme-synced the cart button to automatically match your active theme colors.
- Unified the UI experience perfectly between online and offline modes.
